WITH dwelling_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        p.houselink,
        CASE 
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('brickwork house', 'brick house') THEN 4
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('condominium', 'condo') THEN 4
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('apartment', 'apt') THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END as dwelling_score,
        (p.dwelling_specs->>'Bath_Count')::int as bath_count
    FROM properties p
),
infra_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        i.infraref,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(i.wateraccess) ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as water_score,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(i.roadsurface) ILIKE 'asphalt%' OR TRIM(i.roadsurface) ILIKE 'concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as road_score,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) LIKE '%available%' AND TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) NOT LIKE '%not available%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as park_score
    FROM infrastructure i
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        h.housenum,
        h.residentcount,
        ds.bath_count,
        ds.dwelling_score,
        inf.water_score,
        inf.road_score,
        inf.park_score,
        (inf.water_score + inf.road_score + inf.park_score)::numeric / 3 as infra_quality_score,
        (ds.dwelling_score + (inf.water_score + inf.road_score + inf.park_score)::numeric / 3) / 2.0 as living_condition_score,
        ds.bath_count::numeric / h.residentcount as bathroom_ratio
    FROM households h
    JOIN dwelling_scores ds ON h.housenum = ds.houselink
    JOIN properties p ON h.housenum = p.houselink
    JOIN infra_scores inf ON p.infralink = inf.infraref
)
SELECT 
    housenum,
    ROUND(bathroom_ratio::numeric, 4) as bathroom_to_person_metric,
    ROUND(living_condition_score::numeric, 4) as living_condition_score,
    ROUND(bathroom_ratio::numeric, 4) as bathroom_ratio
FROM combined
WHERE living_condition_score > 3 AND bathroom_ratio > 0.5
ORDER BY bathroom_ratio DESC;

WITH dwelling_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        p.houselink,
        CASE 
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('brickwork house', 'brick house', 'brickwork  house', 'brickwork\thouse', 'brick  house', 'brick\thouse') THEN 4
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('condominium', 'condo') THEN 4
            WHEN TRIM(LOWER(p.dwelling_specs->>'Dwelling_Class')) IN ('apartment', 'apt') THEN 3
            ELSE 1
        END as dwelling_score,
        (p.dwelling_specs->>'Bath_Count')::int as bath_count
    FROM properties p
),
infra_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        i.infraref,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(i.wateraccess) ILIKE 'yes%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as water_score,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(i.roadsurface) ILIKE 'asphalt%' OR TRIM(i.roadsurface) ILIKE 'concrete%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as road_score,
        CASE WHEN TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) LIKE '%available%' AND TRIM(LOWER(i.parkavail)) NOT LIKE '%not available%' THEN 4 ELSE 1 END as park_score
    FROM infrastructure i
),

    SELECT 
        h.housenum,
        ds.dwelling_score,

)
